decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records that historical no-code reward backfill is not required. The existing ticket-and-commission totals rule continues to require correct future accounting, so no additional update is necessary.
The source discussion concerns historical backfill of no-code ticket and commission attributes on the leaderboard and NFT metadata, not the general reward values shown in the NFT detail summary.
Waiving historical reward-attribute backfill does not change whether NFT metadata and asset endpoints resolve successfully.
The source context specifically identifies leaderboard and NFT-attribute backfill. It does not necessarily waive or change dashboard reward-display requirements.
Historical no-code reward-attribute backfill is independent of public mint, prize-pool, referral, and draw-counter statistics.
The backfill waiver concerns historical ticket and commission accounting, not which successfully minted NFTs appear on the dashboard.
The source decision does not alter NFT cover, image, metadata-image, or wallet presentation behavior.
Waiving historical reward-attribute backfill does not change the NFT's permanent mint-number referral-code identity or where that code is displayed.
The source decision concerns tickets and commissions from no-code purchases and does not change badge triggers, thresholds, or award destinations.
The historical reward-attribute backfill waiver does not alter how books, referral codes, badges, or active and expired tickets behave on NFT transfer.
The source decision does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion, supported payment methods, or automatic mint flow.
Waiving backfill of historical no-code reward records does not change how fiat buyers access wallets, dashboards, commissions, tickets, prizes, or reward guidance.
